notes: Small fitted parameters for the served NBA/WNBA model, committed so the RunPod export needs no new artifact.
Every value was chosen on EARLY seasons only, before the reported walk-forward seasons (NBA 2024-25 on, WNBA 2025 on):
Elo K / home advantage / carry-over: grid on NBA 2022-23 + 2023-24 (best K=16, HCA=60, carry 0.75, log-loss 0.6310, n=2638) and WNBA 2024 (K=30).

Ratings half-life / L2 / prior-season weight: grid on NBA 2022-23 + 2023-24 (best margin+total MAE: 45 days, L2 4, weight 1.0) and WNBA 2024 (90 days, L2 2; the prior-season weight is not identifiable from one season, kept at 0.5).
Win-model C: walk-forward on NBA 2022-23 + 2023-24 (C=0.02 Brier 0.2196 vs 0.2205 at C=0.01 and C=0.05); the WNBA reuses it.
The L1 logistic regression itself is refit at every export on all completed games before the bake (and per 14-day block for the walk-forward history), so it has no stored coefficients.
sigma_defaults are cold-start values only; once 100 out-of-sample residuals exist the rolling out-of-sample sigma is used.

calibration: Platt map fitted only on EARLIER walk-forward predictions (warm-up seasons included), shrunk toward the identity (prior_strength in units of summed log-loss; identity below min_oos predictions). Fixed a priori, not tuned on the reported seasons.

leagues.<league>.win_model overrides the global win_model for that league. WNBA serves calibrated Elo-MOV (type elo): on the WNBA acceptance subset the L1 model minus Elo Brier was +0.0013, 95% CI [-0.0015, 0.0041], and the binding review rule prefers Elo where that CI includes 0. NBA keeps the L1 model (pooled 2024-26 regular season: -0.0020, CI [-0.0039, -0.0002]).

data_guard: a league whose tables lack a season from margin_warmup_from_season through the current one, whose complete season has fewer than min_season_share x the median complete-season game count, or whose season has box scores for fewer than min_boxscore_share of its finals keeps its previously published record and gets no upcoming boards. season_started_by_mmdd: the date by which the current season has surely started (zero games after it = missing data).
